default_companion_animation.description: Same approved 3D lion; 20 local frames with state expressions, speech, standing dance and laugh
default_companion_animation.preparation: Reference-image pose sheets generated with Muse Image. Local Apple Vision foreground masking, edge cleanup, normalization and PNG atlas packing. Standing dance frames reuse the earlier generated lion dance loop; its final pose repeats the first to close the cycle. Native movement and 240 ms transitions are procedural, not generated video.
